style: Use case: illustration-story / scientific-educational. ONE children's science picture book illustration, landscape aspect 1216:832. Warm watercolor and colored pencils on fine cream paper, friendly refined rounded shapes, clear educational detail and believable construction, age 4-8. No text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermarks or panel borders. Leave important objects comfortably inside margins. No baked-in arrows; all labels and arrows are added separately by the website.
scenes: Cover: gentle garden panorama centered on young apple sapling with delicate pale pink blossoms, beneath it a cutaway patch of soil reveals a tiny brown seed opening and roots downward. Warm sunny meadow, friendly little earthworm in soil and butterfly above; rich but uncluttered, no faces on the tree.

Closeup soil cutaway: one small teardrop brown apple seed nestled in crumbly warm moist earth at center, intact seed coat not yet germinating. Friendly anatomically simple earthworm curling nearby to right, pebbles and fine soil layers. Aboveground thin strip of grass and pale sky. Quiet sleeping mood, no bed or blanket.

Ground-level cross-section after gentle rain: brown seed just under soil surface splitting open, white first root curves DOWN, small green stem reaches UP out of soil with two cotyledons. Large raindrops falling aboveground to left; no water underground floating like bubbles. Show seed, sprout, raindrops separately.

Close scientific garden soil cutaway: young apple sapling with thin branching white-tan roots extending down and sideways from stem at ground level. One gray rounded stone lower-left and pink earthworm right, roots not worms. Blue sky strip top, green stem visible above soil. Root network fills majority image.

Aboveground closeup of a healthy young apple seedling. Strong slender central green upright stem and two clear rounded oval fresh green leaves, their veins visible; soft sun in upper-left sky, a friendly smiling sun is okay but no text. Soil ground below, not a mature tree.

Closeup apple branch with exactly one prominent five-petaled pale pink apple blossom, yellow stamens at center and small serrated green leaves. One colorful butterfly approaching to right with TWO pairs of wings and slender antennae. Soft out-of-focus garden behind, flower not a tulip or rose.

Extreme close educational view: fuzzy honeybee with six legs and translucent wings lands on five-petaled pale pink apple blossom, yellow pollen visible on stamens and bee's hind-leg pollen baskets. Another similar flower softly visible behind, clear distinction bee and flower. No human face or exaggerated giant stinger.

Apple branch bearing one large ripe red apple at center-left, green serrated leaves clearly visible right. Small clean cutaway wedge removed from apple front shows white flesh and brown seeds in central core; wedge beside fruit as conceptual cutaway, not whole apple floating. Soft orchard background.

Wide seed dispersal scene explicitly comparing different plants: apple tree at left, small finch flying center-right holding a tiny brown seed in beak; a dandelion plant lower-right releasing a few white parachute seeds on breeze. Fluffy seeds visibly originate from DANDELION, not from apple tree. No arrows, no labels, no rain.

Fresh green meadow, small apple seedling foreground center planted firmly in earth, two new leaves and thin stem. Puffy white cloud high-right in blue sky, soft wildflowers in distance. Sense of new beginning, no flower or fruit on tiny seedling.

Garden scene: leafy apple tree to left, cheerful child in yellow shirt safely watering a vegetable patch center-right, carrots leaves and lettuces foreground. Tree, child and vegetables all clearly separate. Warm sunlight, realistic child hands, no chemical sprays, no text.

Garden vocabulary still life on cream paper: separate brown apple seed, seedling with roots exposed in a clean soil cutaway, leafy stem, five-petaled pink apple blossom, bee, ripe red apple with half showing seeds. Balanced spacious arrangement, botanical watercolor objects, no text, no panel dividers.
